data.content_ref: inline:The target claims dominance over lease-based rivals because the log 'records completion before reclamation can observe death,' but this temporal ordering is equally achievable by any correctly implemented lease protocol (the holder commits its seal to durable storage before the lease expires). Because the adjudication relies on an invariant that does not discriminate between the rivals, the claimed dominance is unsubstantiated and fails the requirement to adjudicate between protocols on the evidence.
